name: Coffee Ratio Slider
description: Horizontal ratio slider that splits a bar into coffee and milk colors with a glowing divider, live percentage labels that spring up and down, on a subtle masked grid backdrop.
contents: Invisible range input over a coffee and milk split bar
Divider handle that glows while active
behavior: Dragging moves the divider and resizes the coffee and milk fills
Bar height and labels spring between half and full height when the value is in the middle range
Divider lights up on hover, focus or drag
Coffee shade and milk opacity change with the value
editableByProps: Starting value, track height, labels and accessibility label
Coffee, milk, divider, grid and background colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the middle range that triggers the label shift
needsCodeEdit.where: inMiddle constant in the first useEffect
width: 300 values on the wrapper div and the input
maskImage style on the grid div

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Default coffee and milk colors are derived from the value
